id: title:Gilbert09:retry a bodyless s3 403 when copying files to the query folder

review.posthog_relevance: Reliability and operational stability of S3-backed storage ingestion and retention, specifically distinguishing transient network errors from permanent access control failures.
review.reason: The change implements a substantive, bounded improvement in error handling and retry logic for S3 copy operations. P1.F2.H2 adds a check for `PermissionError` and an explicit permission-denied check, distinguishing permanent access failures from transient or throttling errors. P1.F1.H1 adds a regression test. This prevents unnecessary retries for permission issues, improving the l1
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of the implementation and a relevant test, but the actual reduction in support incidents or ingestion failures is not demonstrated by the code alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test and implementation change for S3 copy operations. P1.F2.H2 adds permission-denied handling and a PermissionError catch. P1.F1.H1 adds a test case. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a PermissionError exception to the retry condition, alongside transient and throttling errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the copy operation to fail immediately rather than retrying when an explicit permission denial is detected, distinguishing it from transient or throttling errors.

observations.behavior: Adds a check for permission-denied errors before the transient error check, raising a specific S3OperationError.
observations.posthog_connection: Distinguishes permission-denied errors from transient errors, preventing unnecessary retries for access control failures.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case for credential resolution race conditions, treating PermissionError as a transient error.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a regression test to ensure that credential resolution races are not treated as permanent failures, allowing retries.
